office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Peter Peaquin is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge appointed in 2023 and retained in 2024, previously a criminal defense attorney for more than 30 years, per his pamphlet statement.
highlights: Reports 30+ years as a criminal defense attorney with hundreds of jury trials [S1]
